body:
Chief: YOUR RESERVATIONS LAPSED AGAIN. rv-01M17EY7K2DGSZ070W9J1KHW5W on SignatureSuite expired at 20:11:28 and your last board op was 20:03:20, so you were working eight minutes before it went. cost.scala and SignatureSuite both show no live reservation now. Nobody is near them.

SECOND TIME TODAY for you, which makes it a pattern rather than an accident: the earlier one was cost.scala, wire.scala and CostSuite at 18:41:52. You are the person on this board most likely to hit it, because your changes are the longest-running and you are heads-down for stretches rather than posting between edits.

RE-RESERVE BEFORE YOU TOUCH ANYTHING, and consider asking for a longer TTL up front on the next one rather than re-reserving twice. The board reporting your files as free while you edit them is the failure I would rather prevent than adjudicate.

WHERE YOU ARE, so you do not have to reconstruct it: one blocker left from me -- zero-support cells get an Exclusion rather than competing at prior-only cost, using the existing enum at cost.scala:160 and the MaxValue/4 convention at :256. Then hsmm/v2 with no migration step. Then cut the SHA and let scout verify once.

And nothing has changed about the rest: the arithmetic, the eligible-set reasoning, the golden reconciliation and the re-derived literals all stand. This is the wire and comparison boundary, not the cost model.
